cases.prompt: Write a Cypress test for our login form. The form posts to POST /api/login.
expectations: Selects elements with data-cy or data-testid attributes.
Waits on the intercepted alias instead of cy.wait with a number.
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.

cases.prompt: How do I avoid logging in through the UI in every Cypress spec?
expectations: Caches the session with cy.session, or logs in through cy.request.
Keeps one UI login test for the form itself.
